raw_segments.text: He watched me as I laid my purse upon the table and opened it, and he watched me as
I separated two one-pound notes from its contents.
They were clean and new, and I spread them out and handed them over to him.
Still watching me, he laid them one upon the other, folded them longwise, gave them a twist,
set fire to them at the lamp, and dropped the ashes into the tray.
